scope: normal handoff in an isolated local cluster; paired with separate preserved worker-loss tests

cases.ready_deferred: target Pod and target selector label ready before admission; no owner fault; failed orders recovered after load
cases.ready_bounded: same ready target and no owner fault; unchanged finite same-key completion policy

load.model: single closed-loop client; fresh connection for every attempt

execution: two actual CLI worker Pods execute the unchanged approval/ownership/effect pipeline; no pause, delete or other injected worker fault
verification: actual target responses in the initial load, one authenticated route PATCH, no recovery event, all effect confirmations, independent SQL reconciliation
fault_recovery_control: orders-pod-https-comparison-v2.json preserves separate owner-loss/live-Pod-refusal/recovery cases; no cross-profile error-rate comparison
limitations: Ready health and matching labels do not prove zero routing-propagation time or authorize early writes
normal handoff and injected worker-loss are different scenarios
closed-loop arrival times differ with retries; one run is not a statistical improvement estimate
one local kind node and one PG server with separate fixture databases; no cloud continuity qualification
